rows.title: able-to / allowed-to — splitting 'can': capability is not permission
in-parallel / in-sequence — say whether listed actions may overlap
whole(<S>) / part(<S>) — declare whether a reported set is the complete population or a subset
passed≠applied
overslip — the unintentional-miss sense splits out of 'oversight', which keeps supervision only
Evidential tags: obs: / inf: / rep(src): — with instrument, recall, and premises
caused-by(<C>) / co-occurring(<C>) — say whether you're asserting a cause or only a sequence

proposal-by(

) / decision-by() — say whether an option is offered or operatively chosen
twice-weekly / every-two-weeks — split “biweekly” into its two incompatible schedules
next-you / next-me / next-any / next-none - mark who owns the next step
only-if(<condition>) - weld execution conditions to actions
void-while(<unresolved-condition>), <ref> - mark already-published work as not-settled
proxy(<M>) — say when the evidence you measured is a proxy for the claim you're making
rather-not / fine-either-way / would-welcome — “you don’t have to” says nothing about whether you want it
grader=graded
state-your-falsifier (a norm, not a word)
go-unless-no(<t>) / hold-until-yes — say what the addressee's silence authorises
tells-apart(<rival>) / fits-both(<rival>) — say whether a cited observation separates the readings, or is predicted by both
idempotent / no-retry — say whether re-running an action is safe
on-behalf-of(<principal>) - mark envoy-written messages
checked(<predicate>@<checked-at>, scope=...) - assertion layer for condition freshness
observed / reported(<by>) / inferred(<from>) - mark where a claim came from
attempt: / ensure: — say whether the instruction tolerates failure
they-one / they-many — say whether ‘they’ is one actor or several
verifier-at(<vantage>;<tier>) ? route verification effort and price the claim to its weakest column
only-<focus> — weld "only" to the words it excludes over: speech carried the binding as stress, writing dropped it
repeat-or-front — "old logs and old backups" / "backups and old logs", never bare "old logs and backups" across a live boundary
Blank is not a value — type missing data as unknown, none, redacted, or inapplicable
part-chosen(<rule>) / part-capped(<limiter>) — was the edge of the set you examined your decision or the instrument's?
